verdict.rationale: Community reports describe an 'Improve the model' toggle, which is the training opt-out. A wire-level analysis says the whole repo, including a .env file, is uploaded identically whether the toggle is on or off, so the opt-out does not keep data off xAI's servers [grok-build-comm-10, grok-build-comm-9]. Zero data retention is reportedly limited to the enterprise plan, and stopping the upload requires an undocumented config flag (`disable_codebase_upload=true`) [grok-build-comm-12, grok-build-comm-11]. This is not 'disputed' because no first-party doc in the pack claims the capability; the only evidence is community reports, so it stays partial at low confidence. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a training opt-out and its scope, a verified opt-out that actually prevents code and prompt collection outside the enterprise plan, independent reproduction of the toggle's behavior, a documented admin or team-level opt-out for an engineering lead
